hello.text: Let's see your blade. Hm. HM. Who sharpened that, a goat?

t0.text: Everything the wall needs and half of what it doesn't. Good iron comes down from the mountain. Better iron's up there. One day I'll go and see.

t1.text: Greyspur. Mines older than the vale. Smiths who've forgotten more than I know. I'd give my best hammer to see their forges. Don't tell them that.
